root_cause: The native <dialog> element does not automatically focus its [autofocus] child when shown via showModal() in this test environment. The _showElement method opens the dialog but does not move focus, leaving it on the triggering element (<body> after Tab key).
repair_strategy: In DialogBase._showElement, after calling showModal() for modal dialogs, synchronously focus the [autofocus] element inside the dialog, falling back to the dialog itself. This ensures keyboard focus lands in the drawer immediately without async timing issues.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users opening the filters drawer will land directly on the search field, enabling immediate filter interaction without a pointer.
functional_risks: Synchronous focus may race with top-layer entry in some environments, but showModal() is synchronous and should establish the top layer first.
If the autofocus element is not focusable (e.g., disabled, hidden), focus() will be a no-op and focus remains on the dialog.
verification_requirements: After opening the drawer via keyboard (Enter on #filters-open), focus is on #filters-search.
Pressing Space on #in-stock checkbox toggles its state.
Pressing Tab twice and Enter on #apply updates the applied output to 'in'.
Escape closes drawer and returns focus to #filters-open.
